title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Deposit Relief at Resort Hotels
content:
## Benefit schedule

When the deposit a Room Reservations resort reservation requires is worked out again after a change raises its nightly rate, a guest whose attached Ashbury Rewards membership holds the Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite tier with at least 50 elite night credits this year has the top elite deposit relief of 50% taken off the deposit; one whose membership holds the Platinum Elite or Gold Elite tier with at least 25 elite night credits has the middle elite deposit relief of 20% taken off; any other guest has none taken off (0%).

The relief reads the Ashbury Rewards membership attached to the reservation: its current tier and its elite night credits for the current calendar year. It takes that share off the deposit the reservation requires as it stands at that point, before the money held is taken off.

| Tier of the attached membership | Elite night credits this year | Deposit relief |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite, Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 50 or more | 50% |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite, Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 49 or fewer | 0% |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite, Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 25 or more | 20% |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite, Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 24 or fewer | 0% |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite, Ashbury Rewards Member | any | 0% |
| No membership attached | — | 0% |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** On a deposit requirement of 319.20 with money held of 140.00: a Titanium Elite member with 52 elite night credits has 50% taken off, leaving 159.60, so the further deposit is 19.60; a Gold Elite member with 25 credits has 20% taken off, leaving 255.36, so the further deposit is 115.36.
